metaDescription: Sketch is a native Mac design app for interfaces and prototypes, with a web Workspace for collaboration and developer handoff. See its features, subscription and Mac-only license pricing, strengths, limitations and alternatives.
overview: Sketch is a native macOS design app for interfaces, icons and prototypes. You design with Symbols, styles, color variables and component Libraries, and the app works offline with documents you can keep locally.

A subscription adds a shared Workspace with real-time collaboration, a web app where anyone can view, comment and inspect designs, free developer handoff, and an iOS app for previewing. If you don't need collaboration, a one-off Mac-only license lets you keep the app forever. Both options include a free MCP server for AI tools.

features.title: Native Mac app
features.text: A fast macOS design app that works offline, with documents you can save locally.

features.title: Symbols and Libraries
features.text: Build scalable design systems with Symbols, overrides, styles, color variables and shared Libraries.

features.title: Prototyping
features.text: Link artboards into interactive prototypes and preview them on the web or an iOS device.

features.title: Real-time collaboration
features.text: Work on the same document together in the Mac app, with comments and version history.

features.title: Developer handoff
features.text: Free handoff in the web app, so developers can inspect designs and export assets.

features.title: MCP server
features.text: A free MCP server lets AI tools work with your Sketch documents, with no AI credits or add-ons.

useCases: UI design for web and mobile apps on a Mac
Design systems with Symbols and Libraries
Designers who prefer working offline in a native app
strengths: A native Mac app that works offline and stores files locally if you prefer.
Unlimited free viewers and free developer handoff on every subscription.
A one-time Mac-only license option for people who don't want a subscription.
Free for students, teachers and educational institutions.
limitations: Editing requires a Mac; there's no Windows or Linux app.
No free plan — only a 30-day free trial.
The Mac-only license has no collaboration, online sharing or iOS previews.
SSO needs the Professional plan, and SCIM provisioning needs Enterprise.
Updates on the Mac-only license are included for one year only.

pricing.summary: No free plan, but a 30-day free trial with no credit card. Subscriptions are billed per Editor, and viewers are free. Prices exclude VAT and other taxes; Sketch is free for education, and qualifying non-profits get 50% off.

plans.name: Standard
plans.note: Billed yearly · real-time collaboration · unlimited viewers · developer handoff · 50 GB per Editor

plans.name: Professional
plans.note: Billed yearly · everything in Standard · SSO · project archiving · permission groups

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: Billed yearly · SCIM · BYOK encryption · unlimited storage · dedicated support for 15+ Editors

plans.name: Private Cloud
plans.note: Isolated AWS environment · choice of hosting location · one-time setup fee

plans.name: Mac-only license
plans.note: One-time purchase · keep the app forever · one year of updates · no collaboration
